yt.title: Canada's economy was 287% of Russia's in 2000. Now? #Shorts
yt.description:
GDP in current US dollars, Canada as a share of Russia, 2000 vs 2025. Source: World Bank (NY.GDP.MKTP.CD). Exchange rates affect this comparison.
Narration is AI-generated.

scenes.narration: Canada and Russia are the two largest countries on Earth by area. Here is how their economies compare, and how that changed.
In 2000, Canada's economy was two hundred and eighty-seven percent the size of Russia's. By 2025, it was ninety-one percent.

scenes.text: Oil and exchange rates swing both
scenes.narration: Both economies depend a lot on energy, so oil prices and exchange rates swing this comparison. What would you compare next?
